title: Hardware Engineer Roadmap
summary: Build from digital electronics and computer architecture into PCB design, embedded hardware, microcontrollers, signal integrity, board bring-up, testing and hardware product development.

facts.Timeline assumption: This roadmap assumes a four-year B.Tech/B.E. from 2026–2030. If an honours/research pathway is available, use the additional depth for VLSI, FPGA/SoC design, high-speed PCB design, power electronics, embedded hardware or hardware security.

horizons.question: What can I enter now?
horizons.output: Build circuit analysis, digital electronics, computer architecture, PCB design, microcontroller and hardware-debugging skills.

horizons.question: How should I specialise?
horizons.output: Specialise in PCB/hardware design, embedded hardware, FPGA, VLSI, validation, high-speed design or power systems.

horizons.question: How should I evolve?
horizons.output: Progress toward senior hardware, board-design, systems or hardware-architecture responsibilities.

horizons.question: How can I remain relevant?
horizons.output: Combine hardware engineering with advanced SoCs, edge AI, chiplets, high-speed interfaces, hardware security and automated design.

rows.text: Circuit theory, electronics, digital logic and engineering mathematics
Analog/digital electronics, transistors, op-amps and power supplies
Design and test a regulated power supply
Microcontrollers, interfaces, ADC/DAC, sensors and embedded hardware
PCB design, schematics, routing, grounding and component selection
High-speed digital design, signal integrity, power integrity and hardware debugging
FPGA/SoC, hardware validation, testing and board bring-up
Working prototype + schematics + PCB + test report

blocks.text: 4-year honours variant
Use the additional academic depth for VLSI, FPGA/SoC, ASIC design, high-speed PCB design, hardware security, semiconductor devices or advanced embedded hardware.
